test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held on: 2 Feb 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

Statements:

1. Some rats are pigeons.

2. All pigeons are mangoes.

Conclusions:

I. All mangoes are pigeons.

II. Some rats are mangoes.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow.
Neither conclusion I nor II follows

solution:
The least possible Venn diagram is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b9e9f0f4e9e35e12a9ae129141fa485e7347ac9279f3ba679dc4ff6eea13c9ab.png] 

Conclusions:

I. All mangoes are pigeons. → Does not follow (As, All pigeons are mangoes → Some mangoes are pigeons)

II. Some rats are mangoes. → **Follow** (As, Some rats are pigeons and All pigeons are mangoes)

Hence, **Only conclusion II follows**.
